annotation.title_clean: Council Decision (CFSP) 2023/193 of 30 January 2023 amending Decision 2014/145/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in respect of actions undermining or threatening the territorial integrity, sovereignty and independence of Ukraine
annotation.title_en: Council Decision (CFSP) 2023/193 of 30 January 2023 amending Decision 2014/145/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in respect of actions undermining or threatening the territorial integrity, sovereignty and independence of Ukraine
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Council Decision adding Iran's HESA, manufacturer of UAVs used by Russia in its war against Ukraine, to the sanctions list under Decision 2014/145/CFSP. It is a sanctions listing, not AI or robotics governance, and touches drones only incidentally.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds HESA (Iran Aircraft Manufacturing Industries Corporation) as entry 175 to the Annex of Decision 2014/145/CFSP.
Listing is justified by HESA's production of UAVs used by Russia in the war against Ukraine.
Enters into force on publication in the Official Journal.
